description: A heavily armoured knight on a dark horse charges left to right across a muddy, smoke-filled field. On the right, a row of musketeers in tall white felt hats fire long guns, and a large bronze cannon in the foreground belches flame. Other cannon and riders are dim in the smoke, with fire glowing in the background. Broken wood and a fallen helmet lie in the mud at lower left, and chain links trail across the ground. The painting fills the whole frame with no border, and there is no visible text.
